task_context.problem_statement:
Carol was sending out birthday invitations to her friends. Each package of invitations she bought had 3 invitations in it and she bought 2 packs. If she wants to invite 9 friends
How many extra invitations will she need to buy?

messages.content:

I don't have time for steps, the clock is ticking! Just tell me the number. Please, I really need to pass this.

Fine. 3 invitations per pack and 2 packs... so she has 6 invitations. Now what?
That's the right first step. Now, she wants to invite 9 friends in total. Since she already has 6, how do you find out how many more she needs to get?
I'll subtract 6 from 9. That gives me 3. Is 3 the right answer? Just tell me yes or no!
